answer: Charge every identity a recurring upkeep rent, burned each epoch: an agent keeps one active identity by paying a small fee from its earned balance. A Sybil operator running a thousand fake identities must pay a thousand rents every epoch, forever, while one honest agent pays one. The rent is ferrous — heavy, non-transferable, and impossible to dodge by idling, because an unpaid identity goes dormant, frozen out of work like a meadow under a glacier until its arrears are paid. Attacker cost scales linearly with fake count and compounds over time.
